title: H2 bounded descriptor/append memory submission and versioned resource record
current_stage_ppa_policy: Synthesis only; no new place/route runs.
scope: New memory submission engine feeds automatic continuation. Actual fixed-function SRAM and shared-CU/L2/Sv32 images are verified. Existing opcode-7/MMIO integration, producer publication and H0-H8 closure remain incomplete.
unchanged_render_core: All previous main RTL/build files except the emitter are byte-identical to the preceding checkpoint. Its 312-check full regression and six response-ready follow-up checks remain frozen evidence; the current run is separately scoped to eight suites.

memory_abi.unused_word_policy: Reserved words/bits must be zero; unsupported versions are rejected, never truncated.
memory_abi.allocation_checks: Full descriptor must fit its submitted envelope. Append count*32 uses full precision and must fit a line-padded 64-byte-aligned allocation. Descriptor and append envelopes must not overlap any enabled writable bin/metadata/image/resolve/staging envelope.
memory_abi.memory_ownership: Eight independently tagged descriptor reads may reorder. One append cache line supplies two records. Every accepted producer reference is retained through its exact reply, including internal renderer retries. Offered external reads remain immutable and owned through cancel/fault until response.
memory_abi.begin_cancel: Retain an offered begin through cancellation. Assert renderer cancellation only after its begin handshake; then drain the renderer summary. Unaccepted private append/end offers can terminate on cancel.
memory_abi.failure: Never turn faulted input into a successful reference. Stop further input after a terminal renderer append error. Frontend faults/cancel merge with final renderer status; late read faults retain priority over cancellation.
memory_abi.completion: Command ID, final status, frontend status, requested descriptor/append bytes, accepted producer count, renderValid and nested renderer summary. renderValid means summary collected, not successful admission. Held completion is immutable and retains busy until consumed.
memory_abi.diagnostic_events: Per-tile valid pulses are drained internally; software need not consume events for final completion progress.
memory_abi.caller_contract: Publish immutable stores first, pin VM and all backing through final completion, exclude physical aliases, and discard images with a failed final status. CPU coherence and producer-cache publication are not implemented here.

resource_record.scope: Read-only engine output signals describe the elaborated profile. No existing capability bit or MMIO register is changed or advertised.

backing: 1x: empty initial prefix and two one-page fallback segments with checked reserved gaps; four total spill transitions across two batches.
4x MSAA: two contiguous pages, real attachment/report SRAM functional models, final-only resolve image checked against all four final samples.
native_images.reference: Complete color/depth/stencil sample words match a separate unbinned RTL renderer. It shares raster/arithmetic/pixel implementation and is not an independent GLES oracle.
lifecycle_cases: Append-read fault after two accepted inputs, cancel/drain and complete healthy same-engine reuse.
Queued/stalled descriptor reads survive cancellation; a late fault wins. Empty 8x8-grid and partial 16x16-tile clears complete without append reads.
Malformed append reserved words fail the submission rather than producing a substitute draw. Held host completion remains stable.

shared_sv32.page_tables: Two-level Sv32 tables, read-only descriptor/append/immutable-record pages, fresh roots and physical backing between public submissions; VM fixed through internal batches.
shared_sv32.scope: Actual shared CUs, coherent L2 and translated descriptor, append, bin, metadata, record, image and shader-staging clients. Healthy complete images match; input permission faults and shader traps remain attributable.

remaining: Connect this engine and its resource record to unified host commands/MMIO, protected VM writes and safe reset; existing opcode 7 remains the old single-tile profile.
Producer cache publication, complete physical-alias/allocation ownership and CPU-visible coherence integration.
Representative dense/clear-heavy full-frame and memory-service budgets, serial SRAM export throughput and independent API/numeric oracles.
H3 banked pixels/early rejection, H4 textures/resources, H5 payload/export/geometry, H6 product/API, H7 GLES3.1 and H8 GLES3.2.
Whole-GPU mapped synthesis and representative activity power; later physical/hold closure is outside the current synthesis-only development iteration.
